lyrics: Yoyuu no nai futari datta shi
Futari kiri shika inai heya de sa
Anata bakari hanashite ita yo ne
Kyou no koto wo waratte kureru kana
Anata ga nemutta ato ni naku no wa iya
Koe mo kao mo bukiyou na toko mo
Kimi to no hibi mo kitto, kitto, kitto, kitto
Mou nakasareru koto mo nai shi
Atarashii hito to narabu kimi wa
Chanto umaku yarete iru no kana
Mou kao mo mitakunai kara sa
Hen ni renraku shite konaide hoshii
Tsugou ga ii no wa kawattenain da ne
Demo mushi dekizu ni mata sukoshi henji
Koe mo kao mo bukiyou na toko mo
Tabun ima mo kirai janai no
Jikan ga tateba kitto, kitto, kitto, kitto
Tsuki akari ni mamono ga yureru
Aka ki aiiro ga mune no oku
Zutto anata no namae wo yobu
Koe mo kao mo bukiyou na toko mo
Kimi ni soete sa zutto, zutto, zutto, zutto

translations.english: Perhaps it doesn't have to be me

translations.romaji: Yoyuu no nai futari datta shi
translations.english: We were both just too strained
Before I knew it, we did nothing but fight
I'm sorry
I've been wanting to talk to you for a long time
I'm sure we won't meet again

translations.romaji: Futari kiri shika inai heya de sa
translations.english: In a room where it was just the two of us

translations.romaji: Anata bakari hanashite ita yo ne
translations.english: You were the only one doing all the talking, weren't you?
If we happen to meet somewhere someday

translations.romaji: Kyou no koto wo waratte kureru kana
translations.english: I wonder if you'll be able to laugh about today
I can't even explain the reason properly, but

translations.romaji: Anata ga nemutta ato ni naku no wa iya
translations.english: I don't want to cry after you've fallen asleep

translations.romaji: Koe mo kao mo bukiyou na toko mo
translations.english: Your voice, your face, and your clumsy side
I don't hate any of it, not any of it
Like dried flowers

translations.romaji: Kimi to no hibi mo kitto, kitto, kitto, kitto
translations.english: The days with you will surely, surely, surely, surely
Fade away
Mm, ha, ha, ha
Perhaps it's a good thing it wasn't you

translations.romaji: Mou nakasareru koto mo nai shi
translations.english: I don't have to be made to cry anymore
And words like "it's always me"
have disappeared
Even a breakup as sad as that
Is forgotten as time passes

translations.romaji: Atarashii hito to narabu kimi wa
translations.english: You, standing beside someone new

translations.romaji: Chanto umaku yarete iru no kana
translations.english: I wonder if you're doing alright

translations.romaji: Mou kao mo mitakunai kara sa
translations.english: I don't even want to see your face anymore

translations.romaji: Hen ni renraku shite konaide hoshii
translations.english: So I want you to stop contacting me out of the blue

translations.romaji: Tsugou ga ii no wa kawattenain da ne
translations.english: You're still as self-serving as ever, aren't you?

translations.romaji: Demo mushi dekizu ni mata sukoshi henji
translations.english: But unable to ignore you, I reply a little more

translations.romaji: Koe mo kao mo bukiyou na toko mo
translations.english: Your voice, your face, and your clumsy side

translations.romaji: Tabun ima mo kirai janai no
translations.english: Perhaps even now, I don't hate them
Like dried flowers

translations.romaji: Jikan ga tateba kitto, kitto, kitto, kitto
translations.english: As time passes, surely, surely, surely, surely
They will fade away oh-oh

translations.romaji: Tsuki akari ni mamono ga yureru
translations.english: Monsters sway in the moonlight
I'm sure something is wrong with me too
Colors float in the darkness

translations.romaji: Aka ki aiiro ga mune no oku
translations.english: Red, yellow, and indigo deep in my chest

translations.romaji: Zutto anata no namae wo yobu
translations.english: I keep calling your name
The feeling of love
Is fragrant once again oh

translations.romaji: Koe mo kao mo bukiyou na toko mo
translations.english: Your voice, your face, and your clumsy side
I absolutely hate every single bit of it
A flower that hasn't withered yet

translations.romaji: Kimi ni soete sa zutto, zutto, zutto, zutto
translations.english: I'll offer it to you and forever, forever, forever, forever
Please hold onto it ah-ah, ah-ah
